name: 07-events-etl
idea: A batch pipeline that ingests product analytics events from three sources (a web SDK, a mobile SDK and a partner S3 drop), validates and normalises them into a canonical event shape, deduplicates by event id, and writes partitioned Parquet to a warehouse table. Late events up to 72 hours are accepted; anything older goes to a quarantine table with a reason. Reruns of a partition must be idempotent. The pipeline publishes data-quality metrics per run, and a schema change in the partner drop must fail the run loudly rather than silently dropping columns. Contains user identifiers, so pseudonymisation happens before landing.
